audience: merchants who run recurring billing and subscriptions in Vindi

useCases.title: Find subscriptions by status and their customers
useCases.text: Search the subscriptions with a Vindi query, such as status. Open one to read its plan, billing dates and current period, then open its customer.

useCases.title: Review bills and charges for one customer
useCases.text: Search the bills with a Vindi query and open one to read its amount, status and dates. Open a charge to see its payment attempt details.

useCases.title: Compare the recurring plans
useCases.text: List the plans and open one to read its interval, billing cycles and plan items.

useCases.title: Add a new customer record
useCases.text: Create a customer with its name and e-mail. The record only adds the customer and charges nothing. Read the saved customer back to check the details.

useCases.title: Update a customer or cancel a subscription
useCases.text: Update the details of a customer record. Cancel a subscription to stop its future charges in Vindi.
